參考文獻

特徵描述

生活型

herb

形態特徵

  • A villose-pubescent herb, mostly 10–15 cm tall.
  • Leaflets broadly rhombic-obovate, slightly emarginate at apex, cuneate at base, villose–pubescent on both surfaces, especially along the veins, coarsely sharp-toothed, the veins divaricated from midrib at an angle about 45 degrees, the lateral leaflets smaller, oblique; stipules entire, nearly glabrous on both sides.
  • Flowers solitary or in a 2–4-flowered raceme; bracts narrow-oblong, pubescent on both sides; calyx 5-lobed, the lobes elliptic, 5–6.5 mm long, 2–2.5 mm wide, acuminate and with 2–3 serrations at apex; epicalyx-lobes 5, similar to calyx-lobes in shape; petals 5, white, obovate-orbicular, up to 10–12 mm long, 9–11 mm wide, the apex rounded, the base abruptly contracted.
  • Achenes small, inserted on an enlarged, fleshy and globose hypanthium.

分布

  • 台灣 : in thickets or along roadsides from medium to high altitudes throughout the island.
